periods.description: Nations decide rights to explore contested ruins through formal Drag-Knight competitions, because ruins contain powerful relics but careless exploration can unleash Abyss disasters.
periods.principles: Countries guard domestic ruins, restrict entry, and settle disputed access by periodic Drag-Ride mock battles including student representative competitions.
periods.classification: international military-diplomatic competition over ruin exploration.
periods.origin: Global scramble for ancient ruin resources after Drag-Rides transformed warfare.
limitations: weak countries may endanger neighbors by awakening Abyss
politics can turn competitions into proxy conflict
